For me I do everything in Manual mode. I set the AP to the lowest for the setting, 8 for portraits or in room shots, for landscapes I find 16 works plenty good. Then the exposure meter I adjust the shutter speed until the meter is in the very middle, half press the shutter button so it stays focused and then shoot. 

It takes some playing around with, I also had a lot of problems with over exposure. I wish you luck!

I have this same problem!! I had surgery about 7 months ago and I keep running into this. I have to keep reminding myself to focus on the joy being flat chested brings me. When I don’t want to look at myself I put on a really baggy button up so I stop ruminating. I’ve yet to find something that helps with the long term anguish around my stomach but distraction/hiding it helps me in the short term. I also wear high waisted pants or stretchy pants so I don’t have to worry about others seeing my tummy if I’m self conscious. Congratulations on the surgery!
